title: Ethiopian Vegetable Stew
description: A flavorful and spicy vegetable stew inspired by Ethiopian cuisine. This recipe is perfect for a weeknight dinner or special occasion.

ingredients.name: Stew
ingredients.notes: any combination of carrots, potatoes, zucchini, etc.

instructions: Heat the oil in a large saucepan over medium-high heat.
Add the onion and cook until softened, about 3-4 minutes.
Add the garlic and cook for 1 minute, until fragrant.
Add the berbere spice and cook for 1 minute, until fragrant.
Add the bell pepper and cook until tender, about 5 minutes.
Add the stew and cook until the vegetables are tender, about 10-15 minutes.
Stir in the coconut milk and bring to a simmer.
Season with salt and black pepper to taste.
Serve hot over rice or with injera bread.
